text:
Ivy H.: SI reported a hard stop on customer install: cluster egress only allowed via corporate proxy with no stable external IPs. Our helm job fails pulling marketplace images.
Ben S.: paste error?
Ivy H.: SI log: 
```
time=\"2026-03-20T14:02:11Z\" level=error msg=\"pull failed\" err=\"Get \\\"https://registry.redwood.ai/v2/\\\": proxyconnect tcp: dial tcp 10.254.1.7:3128: connect: network is unreachable\"\n```
Carlos V.: options: 1) netops whitelist our registry CIDRs for install window, 2) signed offline bundle -> import into local mirror, 3) prefetch images from a node that has egress (DaemonSet/Job).
Maya P.: customer is PCI environment; whitelisting is a no-go. They prefer the offline bundle + verification steps.
Ben S.: we have signed bundles and a mirror-import checklist. Link: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/offline-bundles/marketplace/v2.1.0-signed.tar.gz
Ivy H.: SI asked for a non-technical checklist their infra team can follow and a signed manifest for SOC proof.
Carlos V.: draft checklist I usually send: 
1) curl -O <bundle>; curl -O <bundle>.sha256
2) sha256sum -c <bundle>.sha256
3) gpg --verify bundle.sig bundle.tar.gz (we'll provide public key)
4) ctr -n k8s.io images import <image>.tar or podman load -i <image>.tar
5) tag & push to internal registry: podman tag && podman push
6) set Helm values to local.registry:5000/redwood and apply imagePullSecrets
Maya P.: add a signed manifest.json with image digests so SOC can validate immutability. Also include exact GPG key fingerprint: ABCD 1234 EFGH 5678 IJKL 9012 MNOP 3456 QRST
integration-bot: marketplace-install job failed for customer-omega (job id 9981) - automation ticket #PART-7320 created
Ben S.: fallback: we can offer a guarded prefetch Job manifest. Two variants: non-privileged (uses podman if present) and privileged (uses hostRuntime tools). Label as "advanced fallback" and attach SOC caveats.
Ivy H.: SI will try mirror import first. If they can't complete in 3 hours they will request approval for a transient privileged prefetch. SI asked us to prepare the prefetch manifests and an SOC approval template.
Carlos V.: I'll assemble: mirror checklist, signed manifest, GPG fingerprint, prefetch manifests (priv & non-priv), and an approval template with timebox and audit steps.
Maya P.: please also add a runbook note for future SIs: "If cluster egress is restricted to dynamic proxies, prefer offline bundle import; prefetch only with explicit SOC timeboxed approval."
Ben S.: ACK. I'll also open a small doc page in the partner-runbook with links and the artifacts.
Ivy H.: thanks team. SI will update when they hit the mirror step or need the fallback. :thumbsup:
